header.title: GradientMesh
header.description: Liquid mesh of soft color blobs behind the child. It adds a decorative layer (`pointer-events: none`) with three blobs drifting over a dark base, and clips everything to the root's radius. `variant` sets the motion: `liquid` drifts softly, `aurora` makes wide sweeps, and `static` keeps it still.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the code they generate. With `static`, `trigger` changes nothing: the mesh always shows.
playground.label: Mesh

base.title: Basic mesh
base.description: With the defaults (`variant="liquid"`, `blur={40}`, `duration={9000}`), three blobs in `primary-400`, `secondary-400`, and `tertiary-400` drift over `neutral-950`. The mesh fills the whole root: size and radius go on the root.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `liquid` moves and scales round blobs. `aurora` uses wider, flatter blobs with horizontal sweeps. `static` freezes the blobs in their starting position.

hero.title: Hero background
hero.description: The typical use: a living background for a featured block. Here with `aurora`, a slow cycle (`duration={14000}`), `intensity="sm"`, and more `blur`, so the text stays readable. The content sits on a surface with `z-index: 1`, so the button still gets clicks.

texts.title: Effects that feel alive
texts.body: Tokens, accessibility, and reduced motion included.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: `from`, `via`, and `to` are the colors of the three blobs. Defaults: gem-system's `primary-400`, `secondary-400`, and `tertiary-400`. Prefer tokens.

blur.title: Blur
blur.description: `blur` is how soft the blobs are: a number is pixels, and any CSS length works too. With little blur you can see each blob's edges.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover` the mesh is hidden and appears when the pointer enters or something inside gets keyboard focus. With `click`, each click shows or hides it. The animation restarts every time it shows.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` is the blobs' opacity: `intensity × 0.9 + 15%`, so `sm` ≈ 47%, `md` ≈ 65%, and `lg` ≈ 87%; only `1` reaches `100%`. It takes a token or a number from `0` to `1`, and tokens read `--gemfx-intensity-*` from the host. Here with `static`, to compare without motion.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is a full drift cycle, in milliseconds. The three blobs share the cycle but start offset. `delay` postpones the start.

asChild.title: On another element (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the mesh is applied straight onto the child, without an extra `div`: the button itself becomes the root and the layer is injected inside at `z-index: -1`, under all its content (loose text included). The child's background is set to transparent so the mesh shows. With gem-system's `Button` the layer fills the whole button, even though it wraps its children in `.gem-button__label`, and the text turns white (`--gemfx-gradient-mesh-ink`) in both themes.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the blobs where they are. `isDisabled` hides the mesh (only the content remains) and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onGradientMesh` fires when the mesh turns on (pointer enter or keyboard focus with `hover`, click with `click`, or mount with `always`) and `outGradientMesh` when it turns off, with the reason in `event.reason`. With `static` they behave as with `always`. The button still gets clicks.

texts.body: Hover the block (or Tab to the button) to turn the mesh on and click the button.

header.title: GradientMesh API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `GradientMesh`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every variant, trigger, and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/gradient-mesh` with its `gradient-mesh.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> (except color) and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onFocus, and onBlur run before the effect's internal logic. Only the variables of the props you pass are written inline (after style). The root's background is cleared from the class, not inline: the layer paints the base. The base layout (display, position, overflow, color) lives in :where(), so any host class overrides it.

items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the blobs stay still in their starting position; the mesh still shows.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps the motion. Only use it when essential.
items.decorative: The layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it isn't announced and doesn't block clicks.
items.focus: With trigger="hover" the mesh also appears when the host or something inside gets keyboard focus (:focus-visible), and the events fire just like with the pointer. With click the root isn't focusable: the keyboard only turns it on when the click comes from a control inside (Enter or Space on a button).
items.contrast: The base is neutral-950 in both themes and the blobs keep moving. Use light text, check contrast against the mesh's lightest color, and lower intensity for long text. On a gem-system Button the text switches to --gemfx-gradient-mesh-ink (white).

items.root: Root. `isolation: isolate` and a transparent background, so the layer shows. `inline-flex`, `position: relative`, `overflow: hidden`, and `color: inherit` live in `:where()` (zero specificity), so a host class overrides them. On `.gem-button`, it swaps the text color for `--gemfx-gradient-mesh-ink`.
items.variant: Active variant. `aurora` changes the blobs' shape and animation; `static` removes the animation.
items.trigger: Active trigger, only with `liquid` and `aurora`. Sets `cursor: pointer` and hides the layer while it isn't on.
items.on: Added while the mesh is on with `click`.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. Pauses the blobs with `animation-play-state`.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Hides the layer and removes the animation.
items.layer: Decorative layer (`position: absolute`, `inset: 0`, `aria-hidden`) with the base fill. Inherits the root's radius. With `asChild` it drops to `z-index: -1`.
items.blob: Each blob: `90%` of the root's size, round, with `filter: blur()` and its own animation.
items.surface: Wraps the child (`z-index: 1`). With `asChild`, the class goes on the child itself: it clears its background and puts the layer under all the content.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Only the variables of the props you pass are written inline (`from`, `via`, `to`, `blur`, `intensity`, `duration`, `delay`). `--gemfx-gradient-mesh-base` and `-ink` never are. Everything else, and those same ones when you don't pass the prop, can be overridden from a class.

items.colors: Colors of the three blobs. Set by `from`, `via`, and `to`.
items.base: Layer fill, behind the blobs. Default `neutral-950` in both themes.
items.ink: Text color on a `.gem-button`: it replaces `--gem-btn-fg` and `--gem-btn-fg-hover`, which were picked for the fill the mesh covers. Default `neutral-0` (fallback `#ffffff`).
items.intensity: Base intensity. Set by `intensity`; default `var(--gemfx-intensity-md, 55%)`. Each blob's opacity is `intensity × 0.9 + 15%`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables GradientMesh reads as defaults. You can redefine them on the root with a class.

items.palette: Default blob colors (with neon, magenta, and amber fallbacks).
items.intensity: Values for `sm`, `md`, and `lg` (`35%`, `55%`, and `80%`). The default uses `md` and the prop writes `var(--gemfx-intensity-*)` for tokens, so redefining them changes the blobs' opacity.

content.title: Content
content.description: What goes in front of the mesh and where the effect mounts.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Drift cycle and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it shows and moves, how it pauses, and how it turns off.

events.title: Events
events.description: `event.reason` can be `always`, `hover`, `click`, `inactive`, `disabled`, or `unmount`. With `static` they behave as with `always`: `onGradientMesh` fires on mount.

items.children: Content in front of the mesh.
items.asChild: Applies the mesh to the single child, without a wrapping `div`. All the child's content, loose text included, stays in front of the mesh. Works with gem-system's `Button`.
items.variant: `liquid` drifts softly, `aurora` makes wide sweeps, and `static` keeps it still.
items.from: First blob color. Prefer a token; default `primary-400`.
items.blur: Blob blur. A number is pixels.
items.intensity: Blob opacity: `sm` ≈ 47%, `md` ≈ 65%, `lg` ≈ 87%, or a number from `0` to `1` (`1` is `100%`).
items.duration: Full drift cycle. Negative values become `0`.
items.trigger: `always` shows it all the time, `hover` when the pointer enters or something inside gets keyboard focus, and `click` toggles it on each click. `static` ignores it.
items.isActive: Shows the mesh. With `false` it hides and `outGradientMesh` gets `inactive`.
items.isDisabled: Hides the mesh; the child stays interactive. `outGradientMesh` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Keeps the motion even if the user prefers less. Only when essential.
items.onGradientMesh: Fires when the mesh turns on: on mount with `always` (or `static`), on pointer enter or keyboard focus with `hover`, or on click with `click`.
items.outGradientMesh: Fires when it turns off: on pointer or focus leave, on the next click, when disabled, or on unmount.
items.classNames: Per-part classes: `root`, `surface`, `layer`, and `blob` (applied to all three blobs).
items.style: Inline styles for the root. The variables of the props you pass are written after it.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
